requirement: Load configuration YAML so that a key written twice in the same mapping is an error pointing at its line, while merge keys and python tag rejection keep working.
skeleton: A merge tag constant, a ConfigError carrying a line, a UniqueKeyLoader SafeLoader subclass overriding construct_mapping to track seen keys, and load_strict converting marked errors to one-based lines.
caption: A PyYAML loader that refuses mappings which repeat a key, where plain yaml.safe_load silently keeps the last value. ConfigError is a plain Exception built from a message and a one-based line, formatted as line N: message. UniqueKeyLoader subclasses yaml.SafeLoader and overrides construct_mapping: it walks the key nodes, skipping merge keys, constructs each key and raises yaml's ConstructorError naming the duplicate key at its mark, then defers to the parent. load_strict(text) calls yaml.load with that loader and turns any yaml.MarkedYAMLError into ConfigError with the problem and the problem mark's zero-based line plus one, chained. The fixture asserts normal loading, duplicate top-level and nested keys with their lines, sibling mappings, merge key overrides, rejected python tags, a one-based syntax error line, and that the global SafeLoader is untouched.

plan.intent: Catch copy-paste mistakes in config files
constraints: UniqueKeyLoader subclasses yaml.SafeLoader without changing the global loader
A repeated key in one mapping raises ConstructorError converted to ConfigError
yaml.MarkedYAMLError becomes ConfigError with a one-based line

rationale.teaches: Override construct_mapping on a private SafeLoader subclass to detect repeated keys before delegating, skip merge keys, and report one-based lines from problem_mark.
rationale.why: Duplicate keys silently drop the earlier value so a config reads correctly but runs with the wrong setting, and zero-based line numbers send people to the wrong line.

ops.docstring: Load YAML with a SafeLoader subclass that rejects duplicate mapping keys.

candidates.why_wrong: Keys are never recorded as seen, so duplicates load silently.
The default safe loader is used and the duplicate check never runs.
The loader extends UnsafeLoader and builds python tuples from tags.
A merge key reaches construct_object and crashes the load.
Errors report zero-based lines, one line above the real problem.
